alignments.note: The waw takes the connective the ASV wrote for it, 'Yea', which stands in rule 14's open list.
Finite verb with subject pronoun and auxiliary (rule 17), headed on the lexical verb.
The preposition takes the 'of' the ASV wrote for its relation ('sing of the ways'); this is the preposition's own word, not the chain's, which stands before 'Jehovah'.
Construct noun with a supplied 'the'; no article morpheme is present (rule 29).
Rectum takes the chain's 'of' under rule 19.

Adjectival predicate of a verbless clause; the construction-supplied copula joins the predicate under rule 20 and the unit heads on the word carrying the lexeme. Discontinuous under rule 25, the ASV fronting the predicate.
Construct noun, subject of the clause, with a supplied 'the' (rule 29).
Rectum takes the chain's 'of' under rule 19.

review_notes: The copula of the second colon goes to the adjectival predicate rather than to the subject nominal, per rule 20.
Both construct nouns take supplied 'the's, no article morpheme standing in either chain.
